# MW Realty LA

> > MW Realty LA provides multifamily property management, investment syndications, and commercial real estate brokerage services across Los Angeles and California markets.

MW Real Estate Group, led by Jeremy Raglin, specializes in multifamily property management, investment opportunities, and market analysis for landlords and investors navigating California's complex rental housing landscape. The site offers tenant services, investor resources, and insights on rental market trends, eviction policies, and affordable housing financing.

## Key Topics

- Property Management
- Multifamily Investments
- Los Angeles Real Estate
- California Rental Markets
- Eviction Moratorium
- Section 8 Housing
- Syndications & Joint Ventures
- Affordable Housing
- Rent Increases & Market Trends
- Landlord-Tenant Law
- Freddie Mac Financing
- COVID-19 Impact on Real Estate
- Investment Property Analysis
- Commercial Real Estate Brokerage
- Tenant Services

## Core Services

- [TENANT CENTER](https://mwrealtyla.com/tenant-center): Tenant portal for rent payment, applications, and maintenance requests
- [SYNDICATIONS & JOINT VENTURES](https://mwrealtyla.com/syndications-joint-value): MW Real Estate Group syndications and joint venture structuring services
- [Property Listings E-Marketing](https://mwrealtyla.com/powerful-property-listings-e-marketing): MW Team Brokerage email marketing services for property listings

## Market Analysis & Trends

- [BLOG](https://mwrealtyla.com/blog): Blog listing covering rental policy, landlord issues, and LA real estate
- [Will multifamily investments flourish even during inflation?](https://mwrealtyla.com/will-multifamily-investments-flourish-even-during-inflation): Jeremy Raglin on multifamily investment resilience during inflation
- [Multifamily Rents Continue To Rise Nationwide](https://mwrealtyla.com/multifamily-rents-continue-to-rise-nationwide): Analysis of nationwide multifamily rent increases by Apartment List
- [Strong Demand, Tight Supply Strengthen Case for New Apartment Development](https://mwrealtyla.com/strong-demand-tight-supply-strengthen-case-for-new-apartment-development): CoStar analysis on apartment development driven by rental demand
- [The Coming Rental Housing Wave](https://mwrealtyla.com/the-coming-rental-housing-wave): Costar and Freddie Mac analysis of rental housing market trends
- [Multifamily 2020 – How The Market Changed And What To Expect In 2021](https://mwrealtyla.com/multifamily-2020-how-the-market-changed-and-what-to-expect-in-2021): 2020 multifamily market review and 2021 outlook by Jeremy Raglin

## California Rental Policy & Landlord Resources

- [California's Eviction Moratorium Has Ended – What Happens Next?](https://mwrealtyla.com/californias-eviction-moratorium-has-ended-what-happens-next): Post-moratorium analysis of California landlord-tenant law changes
- [Is Section 8 Good for Landlords in California? Part 2](https://mwrealtyla.com/is-section-8-good-for-landlords-in-california-part-2): Section 8 benefits analysis for California landlords and investors
- [Many Multifamily Owners Turning To Property Managers Amid Increased Demand](https://mwrealtyla.com/many-multifamily-owners-turning-to-property-managers-amid-increased-demand): Buildium report on rising demand for LA property management services
